
'''Yatsurugi Shrines''' (八剣神社, also written as 剱神社, 劔神社, or 劍神社) also read as Yatsurugi Shrines refer to [[Shinto shrine|Shinto shrines]]. These shrines often enshrine eight swords as sacred objects or deities, including [[Susanoo-no-Mikoto]], [[Ōkuninushi]], and [[Yamato Takeru|Prince Yamato Takeru]].

* [[Yatsurugi Hachiman Shrine]] - Located in Fujimi, [[Kisarazu]], Chiba Prefecture.

* [[Yatsurugi Shrine]] - Located in Okudo, [[Katsushika]], Tokyo.
* [[Yatsurugi Shrine (Chōfu)]] - Located in Kikunodai, [[Chōfu]], Tokyo.
